thread_analysis.thread_summary: Topre Corporation (contacts Seiji Hiraki, Yuta Morimoto) continues the same R4HA/keyboard family Bluetooth certification project with Allion (Toshitaka Mochizuki, Itsuo Sakai) already extensively documented in thread_0211 and thread_0224 — covering the same HOGP/BAS/DIS/HIDS PTS debugging arc (TSPC_BAS_2a_1/TSPX_security_enabled settings, HIDS Input Report Notify requirements across Media key/mouse/App Tx, Service-supported-over-BR/EDR setting), the same printed-vs-unprinted keycap variant question, the same Windows 11/Windows 12 WHQL timing question, and the same Listing Owner reassignment request — through to final Submission and registration completion (August 2025). This thread additionally introduces one genuinely new technical issue: a BAS Battery Level change-notification test that kept failing due to a voltage-detection-cycle timing mismatch between the test's voltage ramp-down and the device's own battery-level sampling interval.

thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Beyond the duplicated HOGP/BAS/DIS/HIDS debugging content (see thread_0211 and thread_0224 for the full record), this thread's new contribution is diagnosing and resolving a battery-level notification test failure caused by a mismatch between the test's continuous voltage ramp-down and the device's own less-frequent voltage sampling cycle, resolved via a discrete voltage-step approach timed to the PTS tool's own prompt.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: See thread_0267_case_01 for the new battery-voltage-detection-timing decision logic; all other content follows the same decision logic already documented in thread_0211's case files.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: See thread_0267_case_01; for the duplicated content, see thread_0211's case files.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: This thread reinforces thread_0211's BAS/HIDS debugging lessons and adds a new one: when a battery-level notification test produces an unexpected device power-off rather than a clean Fail, suspect a voltage-ramp-speed versus device-sampling-cycle mismatch and request the device's actual detection thresholds/cycle timing rather than continuing to adjust the test's voltage curve by trial and error.
